details.description: Mistral Medium 3.5 (API version 26.04) is Mistral AI's current mid-tier flagship model, a dense 128B-parameter model released as open weights under a Modified MIT license. Mistral AI's documentation dates its release April 28, 2026, and its public launch post is dated May 22, 2026. It unifies instruction-following, reasoning and coding in a single model, with a 256K-token context window, per-request configurable reasoning effort, and vision input, and is built for long-horizon agentic tasks that call multiple tools reliably. It is now the default model behind Mistral's Le Chat assistant and replaces Devstral 2 as the default in Mistral's Vibe coding agent.
advantages: Scores 77.6% on SWE-Bench Verified (Mistral AI launch post).
Scores 91.4 on the τ³-Telecom agentic benchmark (Mistral AI launch post).
Reasoning effort is configurable per request, for long-horizon tasks that call multiple tools reliably (Mistral AI launch post).
Unifies instruction-following, reasoning and coding in a single dense 128B-parameter model (Mistral AI launch post).
Released as open weights under a Modified MIT license (Mistral AI documentation).
disadvantages: Supersedes Mistral Medium 3 and Mistral Medium 3.1, which Mistral AI's models overview page lists as deprecated with retirement on August 31, 2026.
use_cases: Agentic coding and remote coding agents (Mistral Vibe)
General chat and reasoning tasks (default model for Le Chat)

sources.title: Vibe remote agents and Mistral Medium 3.5 - Mistral AI

notes: Mistral AI's own docs page for this model (docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-medium-3-5-26-04) explicitly lists 'mistral-medium-2604' as an alias alongside 'mistral-medium-3.5' and 'mistral-medium-latest', confirming this target and mistral-medium-3-5/mistral-medium-3.5 in the same batch are the same model. That docs page also lists audio as a supported modality, which the catalog's facts do not include (catalog lists only image_input, text_input, text_output); kept the catalog's modality per instructions. Context window (256K = 262,144 tokens) matches the catalog's facts exactly. Mistral's docs give an April 28, 2026 release date while the public launch blog post is dated May 22, 2026; both are noted rather than resolved to one date.
